moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins today with reigning champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City, marking the start of Matchweek 1.

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: The whistle blows! The Premier League 2026/27 season is officially underway today. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Arsenal's Title Defence
angles.copy: Arsenal kick off their title defence against Coventry City today. Can they hold onto the trophy, or will a new champion emerge?

angles.name: Zandvoort Buzz
angles.copy: The Orange Army is out in force! F1 brings the noise to Zandvoort this weekend. Get ready for some high-speed drama.

angles.name: Festival Vibes

angles.name: Dorset Sounds

angles.name: Weekend Plans
angles.copy: If you're in London, All Points East starts today! Get ready for a week of incredible music in Victoria Park.
